note: Lane graph for left-hand traffic (build_slice.py). Lane: p=flat [x,y,...] polyline (local metres), n=next lane ids, a/b=from/to node, c=class (0 main, 1 residential, 2 service/lane), w=road width, j=junction connector, r=on the Badi Chaupar ring, y=give way (enters the ring). Node: [x, y, 1 if slice edge]. walks: pedestrian polylines; busy: 1 for walks along bazaar shop fronts.
